# DATA-AI Code of Conduct

## The short version

Be decent. Argue the idea, not the person. Don't be a creep. If somebody tells you to stop, stop.

That's the whole document, basically. The rest is the boring details for the corner cases.

## The longer version

We want this to be a place where people — anyone, regardless of background — can build things together without having to also perform a constant micro-aggression management simulation. So:

**Good behavior looks like:**

- Empathy. People come from different places and have different days.
- Listening. You can disagree, just disagree with the actual argument.
- Owning your mistakes, quickly and without a five-paragraph defense.
- Helping new people get oriented.

**Unacceptable behavior:**

- Harassment of any kind — verbal, written, physical, or via code review.
- Discrimination based on anything irrelevant to the work.
- Sustained trolling, brigading, doxxing, or sharing private info.
- Sexual attention you wouldn't be comfortable with a stranger doing to you on the street.

## What happens if someone breaks the rules

We start with a private conversation. If it continues, we remove the person. We don't do warnings-as-public-performances.

## Reporting

Open a private issue, or email the maintainers (see the repo's security tab for contact). We'll keep it confidential and follow up.
